defs.def: in a way that is just possible but only with difficulty 仅仅；刚刚；勉强可能

ex.s: At the side of roads, behind school playgrounds and on all kinds of unloved pieces of land across towns and cities, tiny forests barely the size of tennis courts are appearing, making a great place for both wildlife and local people who may not normally have easy access to nature.
ex.t: 在路边、学校操场后面以及城镇中各种被冷落的土地上，面积仅相当于网球场的小森林正在出现，为野生动物和通常不易亲近自然的当地居民都创造了好去处。

ex.s: One soldier recalled how he barely made it with bombs falling all around him: “I was the first one out.
ex.t: 一名士兵回忆起他在炸弹四下落下时勉强逃生的情形：“我是第一个冲出来的。”

defs.def: in a way that almost does not happen or exist 几乎不；几乎没有

ex.s: I’m telling you, my happy feet barely touched the ground all the way home.
ex.t: 跟你说吧，一路上我高兴得双脚几乎没沾地。

ex.s: Their eyes barely move, and they always have the same distant expression on their faces.
ex.t: 他们的眼睛几乎不动，脸上始终是那种疏离的神情。

ex.s: In November, a cold, unseen stranger, whom the doctors called Pneumonia,arrived inGreenwichVillage.Mr Pneumonia placedhis icy finger on Johnsy; and she lay, barely moving, in her bed staring at a blank wall under her blanket.
ex.t: 11月，一位医生们称作“肺炎”的冷酷而不露面的陌生人来到了格林尼治村。肺炎先生把冰冷的手指放在约翰西身上；她躺着，几乎一动不动，裹着毯子盯着一面空墙。

defs.def: just; certainly not more than (a particular amount, age, time, etc.) 刚好；不超过（某个数量、年龄、时间等）

ex.s: It was barely ten o'clock at night.

defs.def: only a very short time before 刚才；刚刚
